entries.prompt: Precise cross-costume BODY PROPORTION repair of image1, one independent Amu transformed Retto sprite. Image2 (school Retto) is the AUTHORITATIVE skeletal body-size and compact cat proportions reference. Both outfits must contain the SAME SIZE CAT. Image3 Hana is MATERIAL FINISH ONLY: short soft sculpted fur, matte felt and readable broad folds, do not borrow its height, outfit or companion. Current image1 has excessively long torso/legs, and oversized hip/skirt/tail volume. REDRAW the body to be as compact and short-legged as image2, while preserving image1's face at its CURRENT EXACT WIDTH/HEIGHT; do not shrink or flatten the head to make the whole sprite smaller. Move the intact head+visor+pink hair accessory down about 80 pixels on the448x640 reference. Anatomical skull top excluding visor/plume should be about y240 on448x640, while keeping original head width about228px. Neutral front seated cat; BOTH forepaws side by side grounded, two smaller rear paws beside them. Feet at y628 on448x640. Make head-to-foot skeletal stature equal to image2, adjusted only for real crouch/jump posture. This is a short seated quadruped cat, not a tall standing humanoid. Keep ONE brown tail the SAME physical size as image2, attached at the compact hips, not a giant ball. Preserve approved costume DESIGN: broad white cape covering shoulders/chest/upper forelegs, pink lining, red edging; white pink visor with red heart and high pink felt side accessory; red scarf tied FRONT CENTER and ONE directly attached pink-plaid Guardian Egg with black band/pink heart. Make egg and frills fit shorter torso; egg about40-45px tall on448x640. White/red cheer pleated skirt with red hip bow and narrow tails stays fancy but fits real compact cat hips rather than inflating its body width; moderate skirt flare. White/pink foreleg warmers fit short actual forelegs; no pompons/floor fur balls/wrist loops/new accessories. Garments follow real attachment/occlusion and short feline limbs. Keep exact blue eyes, original face markings, nose, muzzle/chin, ears, palette and matte short-fur/felt materials. Face remains ROUND and upright with full forehead and chin, never compressed sideways. One complete fullbody sprite on true transparent background, same portrait7:10 canvas and margins, no text/companion/effects, not a grid.
